title: Seedance 2.5 Flash vs Seedance 2.5: Quality (2026)
summary: Seedance 2.5 Flash vs Seedance 2.5: the same start frames and prompts on both in Flick, side by side, with measured render times and the price of each shot.
body_markdown:
### Is Seedance 2.5 Flash as good as Seedance 2.5?


In our three tests at the same settings, Seedance 2.5 Flash matched Seedance 2.5 on a spoken line, a latte pour and a crane shot. Seedance 2.5 held a steadier camera on the dialogue and drew a fuller rosetta, and it also renders 1080p.


### How much cheaper is Seedance 2.5 Flash?


A third cheaper in Flick: a 5 second shot at 720p costs 160 credits on Seedance 2.5 Flash and 240 on Seedance 2.5, and 70 against 105 at 480p.


### How fast is Seedance 2.5 Flash?


Our Seedance 2.5 Flash shots in Flick took 94 to 101 seconds each from start to finished file, against 152 to 295 seconds for Seedance 2.5 on the same shots, measured on November 20, 2026.


### Does Seedance 2.5 Flash make sound?


Yes. Seedance 2.5 Flash makes sound with the shot, including spoken lines written in quotes, at the same price with Generate Audio on or off. Our dialogue test came back word for word.


### What resolution is Seedance 2.5 Flash?


Seedance 2.5 Flash renders at 480p or 720p in Flick, with shots of 4 to 30 seconds. Seedance 2.5 renders at 480p, 720p, 1080p or 4K.
